title: Reverse Pec Deck
summary: A machine reverse fly for the rear delts and mid upper back.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: pec deck / rear-delt fly machine.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for rear delts (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly rear delts total.
Library rating 0.5 for upper back (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.4 for traps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly traps total.

setup.text: Sit facing the pad with the handles at shoulder height.
Hold the handles with a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms back and out until they're in line with your body.

form_cues.cue: Keep a slight bend in the elbows
Sweep the arms back and out
Return slowly without the stack touching
Move at the shoulder and don't squeeze your shoulder blades too hard, to keep the work on the rear delts.

mistakes.text: Pulling with the back by squeezing the shoulder blades hard.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
